originality.rationale: A prior wheel Fourier finding already establishes the mod-three invertibility criterion and universal four-divisibility. The new claim is restricted to sharp attainability: the minimum nonzero multiplier magnitude is exactly 1 or 4 in every dimension, hence the exact pseudoinverse norm. This is not implied by an odd/everywhere-four-divisible spectrum alone. The necessary transfer signings are additional proofs, with bounded priority risk.
residual_risks: An unidentified earlier ±1-evaluation or signed wheel-tree-polynomial paper might imply the precise spectral gap; bounded search does not prove uniqueness.

value.rationale: The prior parity and singularity theorem leaves the exact Hilbert stability scale undetermined. The new construction finds minimizers for every n, yielding precise all-dimensional Moore--Penrose inverse norms and positive spectral condition numbers. This is a natural missing spectral invariant requiring nontrivial six-periodic signed transfer witnesses.
